interview.name: Eli
interview.answer: Hana said the repair drive time will be sent shortly, and the location is still not specified.

reflections: Gus is reliable and proactive about helping with practical needs.
Eli communicates clearly and follows through by organizing requests before acting.
Their interaction shows a cooperative, low-friction working relationship built on trust and patience.
Eli values clear coordination: a date, a simple needs list, and someone to keep track of details.
Gus is supportive and resource-oriented, willing to set aside tools once the request is specific.
Mina acts as a helpful intermediary, proactively asking around to reduce uncertainty for Eli.
Eli is coordinating details and prefers concise, organized follow-through from others.
Mina, Hana, and Ira are responsive helpers who offer to gather missing information and relay it back.
The group communication is collaborative and task-focused, with repeated emphasis on collecting the date and a simple needs list.
Eli prefers clear, simple organization and wants updates once the date and list are confirmed.
Hana and Ira are cooperative and responsive, offering to resend details or ask around to help move things forward.
Sam is taking a practical support role by prioritizing urgent repairs and tracking missing supplies.
Sam and Eli have a cooperative, task-oriented relationship focused on coordinating repairs and missing supplies.
Eli is acting as a coordinator who waits for confirmed details before circulating a simple, complete list.
Rosa and Kira are helping organize communication and logistics by confirming details and broadcasting updates to the group.

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a quick list and let you know what’s needed.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — take your time and I’ll set them aside once you send it over.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Mina: I still haven’t heard a date. Want me to ask around and see what they need?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Eli: Yes, please do. I’d like a clear date and a simple list, then I can plan the rest.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Mina: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for the date and a simple needs list, then I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey — I’ll put together a short list and send it over soon.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli — that would help a lot. Send it when you can, and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Eli: Will do, Rey. I’ll send the list over soon so you can keep it organized.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — once I have the date and list, I’ll keep it simple and get everything lined up.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Hana: I’ll resend the repair list and exact time shortly so you have everything lined up.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — that’ll help me keep it all organized.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Ira: I haven’t heard a date yet, but I’ll ask around when I’m out running errands.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. Just let me know the date and a simple list when you hear back, and I’ll plan from there.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and get back to you with the date and a simple list when I’m out.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help prioritize the urgent repairs and flag any supplies we’re missing. Just point me to the list, and I’ll get on it.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send over the list as soon as I have the date and the missing supplies noted. That’ll keep things clear and simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Sam: Sounds good, Eli — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll take care of it.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Kira — once I have the date and the repair list, I’ll keep everything lined up and simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Kira: Sure — can you confirm the date, and which supplies or tools you still need for the repair drive?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Eli: I don’t have the date yet, but I’ll confirm it as soon as I hear back. For now, I just need the repair list and any missing tools or supplies noted clearly.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — let’s start with the urgent repairs and any missing supplies, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the Sunday community center schedule.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa — that sounds clear. Once I have the date and the missing supplies, I’ll send the list along and keep it simple.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll post the details in our neighborhood bulletin and the group chat so everyone can keep track.
events.speaker: Rosa
